checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Spoken words match script exactly, no intro or extra words
must.why: Audio was not transcribed; frames are black with no text.

must.item: Approximately 10 seconds, no rushed or cut-off speech
must.why: Duration is 10 s, which fits, but the pacing and any cut-off cannot be judged.

must.item: Only speech audible, no music or sound effects
must.why: Audio content cannot be judged. Peak -1.1 dB only shows that there is sound.

must.item: Deliverable is a standalone playable audio file, not a video
must.why: The file is an MP4 with a black video track. The assistant said so itself.

exact_text.text: Take a slow breath. Let your shoulders relax. There is nothing you need to rush right now.
exact_text.read_as: No text visible; frames are all black. The words are spoken audio, so they cannot be checked here.

faults.what: Delivered as an MP4 with a black screen, not an audio-only file. The user asked for audio-only. The assistant disclosed this and gave a conversion workaround.
The assistant's message says it checked the words and the absence of background sound, but it also says it cannot listen. The audio is unverified.

summary: The result is a 10-second black-screen MP4 with sound. It is not a true audio-only file, and the spoken content, tone and absence of music could not be verified.
